name: # Standard reports of the team
group: one line per report. Standard reports proposes those that fit the simulation.

name: # type: mass flow | area average | mass-flow average | maximum | minimum | heat flow | expression (field = the expression)
# surfaces: name prefixes joined by + (IN
surfaces: ...) or REGIONS. Surfaces of fluid regions are ticked by default

name: #   solid-side surfaces in conjugate heat transfer are listed but not ticked. condition: energy | unsteady | needs <report> <report>
# criterion (optional): stopping criterion on the monitor of the report
#   It is created disabled
group: append ' on' to create it enabled. mean (optional): last <n> creates the report <name>_mean

name: #   the mean of the monitor over the last n samples (iterations
group: or time steps of an unsteady run).

name: # A standard report that exists is proposed again when there are new surfaces with its prefixes. Create adds them to it.
# options (optional
group: words): debug = not ticked by default
type: the group can be removed as a set in Reports > Predefined;

name: #   location = x
type: z of the extreme cell as collocated values of a maximum or minimum report (Output window).

name: #   plot=<name>: the report goes in the plot "<group title> <name>" (folder of the group); log: logarithmic y axis.
# REGIONS: the regions where the field exists; one report per continuum (<name>_<continuum>) when there are several.
# field: a field function name
group: or <name>:magnitude for the magnitude of a vector.

name: r_mdot_net
meaning: net mass flow: tends to 0 when mass is conserved

name: r_mdot_imbalance_pct
meaning: mass imbalance in % of the inflow (converged: below 0.1)

name: r_div_U_max
meaning: maximum velocity and its location: jets in bad cells, narrow gaps

name: r_div_p_min
meaning: minimum pressure and its location: unphysical low-pressure pockets

name: r_div_p_max
meaning: maximum pressure and its location: spikes, checkerboarding, blocked flow paths

name: r_div_p_abs_min
meaning: minimum absolute pressure and its location: near 0 before the equation of state fails

name: r_div_T_max
meaning: maximum temperature and its location: cells at the upper temperature limit

name: r_div_T_min
meaning: minimum temperature and its location: cells at the lower temperature limit

name: r_div_mut_ratio_max
meaning: maximum turbulent viscosity ratio and its location: turbulence model blow-up

name: r_div_Co_max
meaning: maximum Courant number and its location: cells over the stability limit

name: r_div_p_out_min
meaning: minimum pressure on outlets and openings and its location: backflow
